title: Anomaly maps: Jade Isles lineage supports
summary: Reveal the Jade Isles anomaly and farm its boss for Karui lineage supports; Memories of the Karui adds a 15% extra-lineage chance, and Forest Mastery adds lineage chance on runs with a Forest-roll Mastered Domain. Owner's routine: two unique Irradiated tablets plus an Overseer on the first run.

budget.build_needs: Kills a Deadly anomaly boss reliably; Overseer tablets and unique tablets cost currency each run.

steps: Set Jado: Trove Seekers, Unforeseen Threats, Partial Translations, Untold Histories; allocate Memories of the Karui and Forest Mastery (Lineage Supports).
Reveal The Jade Isles (Eye of the Storm): activate a Karui Beacon in a nearby map to lift the Maelstrom.
First run: Visions of Paradise + Mastered Domain (Forest roll) + one Overseer Tablet (one suffix: Map Boss rarity, else quantity).
Buy a Mastered Domain with the Forest roll for each run (1 use) to keep Forest Mastery active; otherwise it does nothing after the first run.
Kill Manoki, the Chosen; sell the lineage supports (unpriced ones show a dash, not 0).
risks: Anomaly bosses are Deadly (poe2db Anomaly Map).
poe2db does not say whether Map Boss tablet mods apply to the anomaly boss; the owner's runs rely on it — verify on your own kills.
The drop list is a community-wiki section, not datamined; which lineage drops is random among the four.
Forest Mastery applies only on runs with a Forest-roll Mastered Domain. poe2db doesn't say whether it raises the anomaly boss's lineage drop.
Whether Mastered Domain's irradiation counts as 'previously Irradiated' for Visions of Paradise is untested.
